therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: TGF-β receptor I kinase inhibition + PD-1 checkpoint blockade
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Immunosuppressive TGF-β signaling inhibition combined with T-cell activation
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Advanced refractory solid tumors, recurrent/refractory NSCLC, and hepatocellular carcinoma

results.target_engagement_evidence: Galunisertib AUC 0-24h ranged from 2220-7322 μg*h/L across cohorts; Nivolumab Cmin ranged from 29.2-43.2 μg/mL
biomarker_changes: No anti-nivolumab antibodies detected in any participants
subgroup_findings: NSCLC: 24% ORR, median PFS 5.26 months, median OS 11.99 months
HCC: 0% ORR, median PFS 5.39 months, median OS 14.52 months
results.dose_information: Galunisertib 300 mg orally, Nivolumab IV (dose not specified)
